question: Should `submitText` become the shared public interactive-handler result for supporting channels, rather than remain separate Telegram- and Discord-specific result contracts?
rationale: The implementation defines a permanent external plugin API and cross-channel semantic promise; source correctness alone cannot determine whether maintainers want that shared contract.

options.title: Adopt the shared result
options.body: Keep one additive `submitText` contract and require each supporting channel to preserve the interaction’s source conversation context.

options.title: Keep channel-specific results
options.body: Add a Discord-specific result type while retaining Telegram’s existing type, avoiding a shared promise across unsupported channels.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want to own generic plugin-driven inbound text submission as a public API.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared result
recommendation.body: Keep one additive `submitText` contract and require each supporting channel to preserve the interaction’s source conversation context.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected paths are covered by repository CODEOWNERS, and recent history ties this person to the current plugin type-surface ownership.
